notes.title: v1.4 - Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Ahoy, Dirgelings! Welcome to the spooktacular v1.4 update of our ghastly masterpiece, where we're diving deep into the shadows to exorcise those pesky bugs haunting our game. We've summoned a team of ghostbusters armed with code and caffeine to vanquish these digital demons once and for all!

First off, we've cast spells on GPUs, making sure they behave themselves. Oh, and for those cursed with potato PCs, fear not! We've made sure to highlight the shoddy GPUs in a devilish shade of red, so you know where the real horror lies.

But wait, there's more! We've embarked on a quest to fix everything from wonky progress bars to unruly animations. We've rewritten handhelds so many times, they're starting to feel like cursed artifacts. And don't even get us started on the cacophony of logging we've unleashed upon the code—enough to make even the bravest adventurer quiver in their boots.

So grab your torches, sharpen your crucifixes, and join us on this spine-chilling adventure through the dark depths of bug-fixing madness! And remember, if you spot any more glitches lurking in the shadows, don't hesitate to scream—I mean, reach out to us on Discord. Until next time, may your code be bug-free and your nightmares be fleeting. Stay spooky, Dirgelings!

Additions

 Item usage / weapon changing animations completely reworked. You should no longer be able to equip and fire a banana. You should no longer eat a shotgun. You should no longer be able to fire a gun while it's equipped on your back!
 New Italian Translations (Grazie Sofia Sybille!)


Changes

 GPU quality calculations should be improved so that higher end GPUs are correctly detected and given higher settings, lower end GPUs are correctly detected and given lower settings.


Optimization

 Converted common frequently used code from Blueprints to C++


Fixes

 Fixed bug where some cave floors in Quetico were wood instead of dirt.
 Corrected issue where some progress bars were not progressing.

notes.title: Major Update in the Works!
notes.notes:
Darkness falls upon us, dear thrill-seekers, as we prepare to pull back the curtain on a chilling new chapter in our supernatural saga. Prepare to tread the treacherous streets of the City of Wakefield, an ominous cityscape shrouded in an all-consuming darkness. Where light falls, it does so reluctantly, leaving shadowy corners untouched, allowing an oppressive sense of foreboding to permeate every grimy alleyway and crumbling edifice.

At the very epicenter of these paranormal disturbances stands the Investigator's Office, a beacon of hope amidst the encroaching chaos. Their mission - to peel back the layers of the city's supernatural underbelly and confront the monstrous entities that lurk within.

Wakefield is a city like no other; it is a palpable nightmare that clings to the consciousness, a dark urban labyrinth echoing with eerie whispers of the past. This haunted metropolis is teeming with hidden horrors waiting to be discovered, pushing the boundaries of your fear further than ever before.

We've been tirelessly weaving this intricate web of dread, fine-tuning each menacing alleyway, each chilling scenario, to give you a uniquely harrowing gaming experience. As we plunge into the final stages of testing and polishing, know that every ounce of our dedication has been poured into crafting this hair-raising installment.

Soon, you'll walk the eerie streets of Wakefield, flashlight in hand, facing the unknown. Are you ready to step into the shadows? The City of Wakefield awaits you, whispering your name amidst its unsettling echoes...

notes.title: Dirge Official Trailer Release
notes.notes:
We've finally completed the trailer for Dirge! This 90 second trailer captures the essence of playing Dirge. 

Watch as the investigators start in the lobby for their paranormal detective force. They receive a call about hauntings occurring in the world. The team gathers and sets forth to fight the evils of the undead. Upon arriving at the site they look for clues to investigate the source of the ethereal evil.

A mistake is made and attention brought to the humans invading their domain of the monsters. The monsters unleashes his fury of minions to attack the mortals and rip them to pieces. One by one he hunts them down while they scramble and use their pitiful lead delivery machines to try and stop them. That may work on some minions and monsters, but others are only weak to electrical lights.

Who will win in this epic struggle? Play to find out.

This represents months of work with our tiny team and an absolutely amazing trailer director AGhnassia for whom we are deeply grateful. Please, let his work speak for itself and check out the video on YouTube below...
